name: 2nd SS Panzer Division Das Reich
source: Published locations of Montauban, Tulle, and Oradour-sur-Glane. Confirm against division KTB / Gliederung. Do not park this unit in the bocage on 6 June.

track.note: Still at Montauban on D-Day. The march north starts 8 June. No 7 or 8 June town row.
track.source: Published commune location, Montauban. Confirm against Das Reich KTB.

track.note: 9 June, Tulle. Keep Tulle off the Oradour and Mortain markers.
track.source: Published commune location, Tulle. Confirm against Das Reich KTB.

track.note: 10 June, Oradour-sur-Glane. I./Der Führer only. Split Der Führer / Deutschland / the panzer regiment once column dates exist. Loire crossings from 13 June are not pinned until a named crossing is sourced. First Normandy fighting is later in the month.
track.source: Published location of Oradour-sur-Glane. Confirm against I./Der Führer records. Do not treat this pin as the whole division.
